title: Privacy Policy | Vertical Studios
description: How Vertical Studios collects, uses and protects your information, including website forms, HighLevel, text messaging consent and your privacy choices.

blocks.body:
Vertical Studios ("we," "us," or "our") operates the website www.verticalstudios.life (the "Website"). Vertical Studios is part of Vertical Life. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose and safeguard your information when you visit our Website, submit a form or engage our marketing services. Please read this policy carefully. If you do not agree with it, please do not use the Website.

## 1. Information We Collect

We may collect information about you in the following ways.

### a. Information You Provide

- **Contact Information**: When you fill out a form on our Website, request a call or contact us, we may collect your first and last name, organization, website, phone number, email address, how you heard about us and any other information you choose to share.
- **Project Information**: Details you share about your organization, goals and marketing needs.
- **Communications**: Records of the emails, calls and text messages you exchange with us.

### b. Automatically Collected Information

- **Usage Data**: Information about how you interact with the Website, such as pages visited, time spent on the site and referring URLs.
- **Device Information**: Your IP address, browser type, operating system and device type.
- **Cookies and Similar Technologies**: The Website and the tools embedded in it may use cookies and similar technologies to keep the site working, protect forms from spam and understand usage. You can manage cookies through your browser settings.

### c. Information from Service Providers

- We may receive information from the service providers that power our Website, forms and analytics about your interactions with the Website.

## 2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

- **Respond to You**: Answer inquiries, set up intro calls and follow up on project requests.
- **Provide Services**: Plan, deliver and manage the marketing services you engage us for.
- **Communicate**: Send you updates by email and, if you have given consent, by text message. You may opt out at any time.
- **Improve the Website**: Understand how visitors use the Website and make it better.
- **Keep Things Secure**: Detect and prevent spam, fraud and unauthorized access.
- **Meet Legal Obligations**: Comply with legal, regulatory and contractual requirements.

## 3. How We Share Your Information

We do not sell, trade or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information in the following circumstances:

- **Service Providers**: With trusted vendors who help us operate the Website and deliver our services, such as website hosting, analytics and HighLevel, the platform that runs our forms, customer relationship management and text messaging. These providers may use your information only to provide services to us.
- **Legal Requirements**: If required by law, such as to comply with a subpoena or court order.
- **Business Transfers**: In the event of a merger, acquisition or sale of all or part of our business, your information may be transferred as part of the transaction.

The sharing described in this section excludes text messaging originator opt-in data and consent. This information is not shared with any third parties.

blocks.heading: 4. Text Messaging (SMS)
blocks.body:
If you provide your mobile number and check the consent box on one of our forms, you agree to receive non-marketing text messages from Vertical Studios about your project inquiry. These may include follow-up on your inquiry, scheduling and project updates.

- **Message Frequency**: Message frequency varies.
- **Costs**: Message and data rates may apply.
- **Help**: Reply **HELP** for help. You can also contact us at studios@thevertical.life or 463-285-8785.
- **Opt Out**: Reply **STOP** at any time to opt out of text messages.
- **Platform**: Our text messages are sent through HighLevel.

### Mobile Information

No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties.

## 5. Analytics

Analytics tools such as Google Analytics may be used to understand how visitors find and use the Website. These tools may collect information such as general location, device type and on-site behavior.

## 6. Data Retention

We keep form submissions and related records for as long as needed to respond to you, provide our services, maintain business records and meet legal obligations. You may request deletion at any time, as described below.

## 7. Data Security

We use reasonable administrative, technical and physical safeguards to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use or disclosure. We limit access to authorized personnel. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## 8. Your Choices and Rights

- **Access, Update and Delete**: You may request access to, correction of or deletion of your personal information by contacting us. We may keep information we are required to retain for legal or operational purposes.
- **Email**: You may opt out of marketing emails by clicking the "unsubscribe" link in our emails or contacting us directly.
- **Text Messages**: Reply **STOP** to any text message to opt out.
- **Cookies**: You can disable cookies through your browser settings, though this may affect how the Website works.
- **Do Not Track**: Our Website does not currently respond to "Do Not Track" signals from browsers.

## 9. Third-Party Links and Embedded Content

Our Website may contain links to other websites, including our sister companies Vertical Life, Vertical Immersive and Vertical Wealth, and our social media profiles. It may also include embedded content, such as videos or forms, from other services. Embedded content behaves as if you visited the other website directly. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these websites and encourage you to review their policies.

## 10. Children's Privacy

Our Website is not intended for individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we learn that we have collected such information, we will take steps to delete it.

## 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will post the updated policy on this page with a revised "Last updated" date.
